{{Quote|The Bane Brigade destroyed my people's capital. We must know the truth.|Krepkit|<ref name="RotBB" />}}
'''Krepkit''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] he was discussing with fellow Generals [[Shodarra]] and [[Uchang]] the news that the famed [[Bane Brigade]] has resurfaced on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after being presumed dead since the [[Battle of Rhen Var]] over ten years earlier. Uchang advised to bring more reinforcements to Hoth, but Shodarra countered by saying that he saw the Bane Brigade perish himself. Krepkit people's capital was destroyed by the Bane Brigade in the past, and he stated that the truth must be uncovered either way.
